assessments.name: Group interactive oral assessment
assessments.description: A group interactive oral assessment based on principles of assessment and intervention. Students attend in groups of four and are assessed individually on their contribution

assessments.name: Year 1 Screener
assessments.description: Students must engage with a communication skills screening interview with a year 4 speech pathology student

assessments.name: CPR Certificate
assessments.description: Students must submit a certificate demonstrating successful completion of a cardio-pulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course, which is required to be verified to start professional practice placements in Year 2.
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 27 Nov 2026 at 23:59

assessments.name: Speech pathology frameworks quiz
assessments.description: In-class quiz on frameworks underpinning speech pathology practice
assessments.dueRaw: Week 03 Due date : 17 Aug 2026 at 09:00 Closing date : 27 Nov 2026

assessments.name: Professional communication with AI agent

assessments.dueRaw: Week 06 Due date : 11 Sep 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 27 Nov 2026

assessments.name: Group reflective discussion video
